sections.description:
LAND REFORMS (BALUCHISTAN PAT FEEDER CANAL)
LAND
REFORMS (BALUCHISTAN PAT FEEDER CANAL)
REGULATION,
1972, RULES, 1985
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 11th March, 1985]
No. CLR‑261 /82.‑In exercise of the powers
conferred by Paragraph 15 of the Land Reforms (Baluchistan Pat Feeder Canal), Regulation,
1972; the Government of Baluchistan is pleased to make the following Rules,
namely:‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) These Rules may
be called the Grant of Land Under Clause (c) of sub‑paragraph (1) of
paragraph 6 of the Land Reforms (Baluchistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972
Rules, 1985.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.‑(1) In these Rules, unless the
context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the meaning
hereby respec tively assigned to them, that is to say :‑
(i) "Application" means an application made for
the grant of land under the provisions of clause (c) of sub‑paragraph (1)
of Paragraph 6 of the Regulation ;
(ii) "Grantee" means a person who has been
granted or deemed to have been granted land under these Rules ;
(iii) "Land" means the land granted under these
Rules ;
(iv) "Regulation" means the Land Reforms
(Baluchistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972 (M. L. R. 117).
(v) "Tenant" means a tenant who has not been
granted land under clause (b) of sub‑paragraph (1) of Paragraph 6 of M.
L. R. 117 ;
(vi) "Joint Tenant" means a tenant and his adult
sons in joint cultivation with him ;
(vii) "Group of Tenants" means tenants in joint
possession of a block of land ;
(viii) "Landless Persons" means a person who is
bona fide resident of a Mauza where the unallotted State land is situated,
Tehsil and District of which such Mauza is a part and does not own/possess any
land anywhere ;
(ix) "Land Reforms Officer" means an officer
appointed as such by the Provincial Government ;
(x) "Collector" means Collector of Nasirabad
District ;
(xi) "Commissioner" means the Commissioner, Sibi
Division ;
(xii) "Board of Revenue" means the Board of
Revenue constituted for the Province of Baluchistan.
(2) Words‑and expressions used but not defined in
these Rules shall have the same meaning as assigned to them in the Regulation.
3. Eligibility.‑As per paragraph 6(1) (c) of the
Regulation. The person/categories of person mentioned therein shall be eligible
for grant of land under these rules.
4. Availability of land,‑(a) The grants under these
Rules shall be made after the claims of the Sanad‑holders under para.
6(1) (c) (first) of the Regulation are satisfied and requirements of the
Government for any scheme/project under paragraph 5‑A of the Regulation
are met;
(b) Rest of the grant shall be made out of available State
land in order of precedence appended to paragraph 6(1)(c) of the Regulation.
5. Method of grant.---(a) Land shall be granted to the
tenant/joint tenants to the extent of his/their cultivating possession to the
maximum of 16/32 Acres in each case ;
(b) The tenant/joint tenants will be required to give an
application for the purpose in the prescribed pro forma ;
(c) The Land Reforms Officer shall on the date fixed hear
the applicant. After taking into consideration all the evidences, examining any
record and making such inquiry as may be necessary, shall pass an order
accepting or rejecting the application ;
(d) Where application is made by different persons in
respect of the same land, the Land Reforms Officer shall, as far as possible,
consider the respective claim of all such applicants before passing any order ;
(e) The applications shall be disposed of in Ijlase Aam in
the Mauza in which the land is situated ;
(f) The Land Reforms Officer after passing his orders
shall supply certified copies thereof to the concerned applicants ;
(g) The order passed by the Land Reforms Officer shall
contain the survey numbers and where a part of survey number is involved, a
rough sketch map of the survey number, shall be added ;
